title: Spanish Essentials (KS3 Spanish)
subject: Spanish
strapline: Core verbs, phrases and grammar to get started.
facts: Greetings: hola (hello), adiós (goodbye), buenos días (good morning), por favor (please), gracias (thank you).
Spanish nouns have a gender: masculine (el) or feminine (la); plurals are los and las.
The verb ser (to be, permanent): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son.
The verb tener (to have): tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tenéis, tienen.
To give your age you use tener: "tengo trece años" means "I am thirteen".
Adjectives usually follow the noun and agree in gender and number: un gato negro, una casa negra.
Question words: quién (who), qué (what), dónde (where), cuándo (when), por qué (why), cómo (how).

quick_quiz.q: How do you say "please" in Spanish?
Which verb is used to give your age in Spanish?

teacher_tips: Contrast ser and estar carefully as students progress.
Pair gender with the article from the first lesson.
Prioritise pronunciation and spoken confidence early.
